title: I accidentally turned LLM memory into program analysis
summary: The author describes an accidental discovery where they repurposed LLM memory mechanisms (likely retrieval-augmented generation or context management systems) to perform program analysis tasks, demonstrating an unconventional but clever crossover between AI architecture and traditional software security analysis.
problem_solved: Explores using existing LLM memory and retrieval mechanisms as a novel approach to analyze and understand program code structure and behavior.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative cross-domain application of LLM architecture that could provide new tooling for security researchers and developers at minimal implementation cost.
